notes: Read SKILL.md, references/system_preparation.md and references/mdanalysis_analysis.md in full. Python examples for setting up, minimizing, equilibrating and running OpenMM simulations and analysing trajectories (RMSD, RMSF, contacts, PCA, H-bonds, free-energy surfaces) with MDAnalysis.

Medium because it tells the agent to install packages: version-pinned `uv pip install openmm==8.6.1 MDAnalysis==2.10.0` plus unpinned matplotlib/pandas into a dedicated venv (SKILL.md:28-29), and optional unpinned `conda install -c conda-forge pdbfixer` / `mamba create ... openff-toolkit` (system_preparation.md:16, 48) flagged as illustrative. These are well-known scientific packages from PyPI/conda-forge installed into isolated environments, so it remains acceptable.

Code writes local outputs (minimized.pdb, *_log.txt, *_traj.dcd, checkpoints, PNG plots) and advises unique output prefixes to avoid overwriting; simulation itself runs offline. No credentials or data transmission.
